title: Send as Excel
subtitle: An Excel file of this worker's issues with their photos, shared to WhatsApp.
ready: {count, plural, one {File ready: # issue} other {File ready: # issues}}, {size} MB.
empty: No issues in the chosen statuses.
tooBig: The file would be {size} MB — too big to send on WhatsApp (about 15 MB at most). It can hold the first {fit} of the {total} issues.
fewer: {count, plural, one {Include the first issue only} other {Include the first # issues}}
failed: The file couldn't be prepared. Try again.

confirm.title: Mark as sent?
confirm.body: {count, plural, one {Mark the assigned issue in the file as sent?} other {Mark the # assigned issues in the file as sent?}} Other statuses don't change.
confirm.refused: Nothing was changed: issue {numbers} can't be marked sent.
confirm.partly: {count, plural, one {# issue was already marked sent before the refusal.} other {# issues were already marked sent before the refusal.}}

toast.marked: {count, plural, one {# issue marked sent.} other {# issues marked sent.}}
